msg: There are two colour groups for the harvest baskets in this game.The first colour group pertains to yellow, green, blue, and orange gnomes and will result in a yellow basket.All other gnomes will belong to the second colour group and shall result in a red basket.If a specific harvest basket is returning 1 or 0 mushrooms, that means that the supply of mushrooms for that basket is depleted; it is best to choose gnomes from the other colour group.The best way to maximise your score is to do the following steps:1. Decide a colour group / Alternate the colour group previously decided.2. Select gnomes from that specific colour group.3. If the return value is 1 or 0 (without the multiplier), go to step 1, else repeat step 2.
